produit: La maison individuelle neuve construite et livree aux Etats-Unis (marques D.R. Horton, Express Homes, Emerald Homes, Freedom Homes)

2016.extrait: Homes closed increased 10% to 40,309 homes, and the average closing price of those homes increased 2% to $292,300.

2017.extrait: Homes closed increased 14% to 45,751 homes, and the average closing price of those homes increased 2% to $298,400.

2018.extrait: Homes closed increased 13% to 51,857 homes, and the average closing price of those homes was $298,900.

2019.extrait: Homes closed increased 10% to 56,975 homes, and the average closing price of those homes was $297,100.

2020.extrait: Homes closed increased 15% to 65,388 homes, and the average closing price of those homes was $299,100.

2021.extrait: Homes closed increased 25% to 81,965 homes, and the average closing price of those homes was $323,300.

2022.extrait: Homes closed increased 1% to 82,744 homes, and the average closing price of those homes increased 19% to $385,100.

2023.extrait: Homes closed increased slightly to 82,917 homes, and the average closing price of those homes decreased 1% to $381,600.

2024.extrait: Homes closed increased 8% to 89,690 homes, while the average closing price of those homes decreased 1% to $378,000.

2025.extrait: Homes closed decreased 5% to 84,863 homes, and the average closing price of those homes decreased 2% to $370,400.

note: Exercice decale clos le 30 septembre : chaque annee de la serie est etiquetee par son annee de cloture (exercice 2025 = 1er octobre 2024 au 30 septembre 2025). Les dix valeurs proviennent des 10-K deposes a la SEC, section Overview des resultats de l exercice. Perimetre : maisons livrees par les activites de construction, hors maisons locatives unifamiliales (3 460 en 2025) et logements locatifs collectifs (2 947 en 2025), qui font l objet de lignes distinctes. Controle croise fait sur 2019 et 2022 avec les communiques de resultats annuels deposes en 8-K, valeurs identiques ; les tableaux par region des 10-K suivants confirment aussi 56 975 en 2019 et 82 744 en 2022. Aucune annee estimee.
